title: Resolution urging US ratification of disability rights treaty
summary: This resolution calls on the US Senate to approve, and the President to ratify, the UN Convention on the Rights of Persons with Disabilities and its Optional Protocol, marking the Convention's 20th anniversary. The Council notes the United States is the only G7 country that has signed but not ratified the treaty, and that nearly one million New Yorkers live with a disability. It argues ratification would strengthen accessibility, nondiscrimination and inclusion protections already established under the Americans with Disabilities Act.
